{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web plugin — Anime maid whale desktop pet with satiety system and real-time LLM interaction","id":"gh:1364510123","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-web-whale-maid","slug":"AcidGr/dsh-web-whale-maid","topics":["deepseek-harness","desktop-pet","dsh","dsh-plugin","whale-maid"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web plugin — Anime maid whale desktop pet with satiety system and real-time L"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ss (dsh) Web plugin — Anime maid whale desktop pet with satiety system and real-time LLM interaction"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-whale-maid (DeepSeek Harness Desktop Pet · Anime Maid Whale)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An interactive, anime maid whale desktop pet plugin customized for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"n interactive, anime maid whale desktop pet plugin customized for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Features LLM thinking and mood linkage, 30,000 Token satiety pool, persistent speech bubbles, mobile"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"-responsive cupboard modal, 5-hour task awareness ledger, and dual-layer persistence."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **8 Mood Frame Animations**:
- `idle`, `hungry`, `happy`, `angry`, `eating`, `scared`, `sad`, and "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"`thinking`.
- Built from a 1024x2048 HD sprite sheet processed with chroma keying and custom despill"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" algorithms for clean, crisp edges on Retina screens.
- **Strict Mood & LLM Linkage**:
- The pet's m"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ood and animation only change when an LLM invocation occurs; otherwise, it remains in its current st"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ate.
- **Thinking Animation**: Whenever an LLM call starts (upon feeding or work session completion)"},{"id":"p7s6","text":", the pet immediately transitions into the `thinking` animation. When the LLM outputs its response, "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"the pet switches to the result mood and renders its speech bubble.
- **Dual-Zone Touch & Persistent "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"Speech Bubble**:
- **Permanent Bubble**: Speech bubbles and moods remain permanently on screen until"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" the next LLM response arrives.
- **Clicking Pet Body**: Opens the antique wooden maid cupboard moda"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"l.
- **Clicking Speech Bubble**: Immediately dismisses the speech bubble and resets the pet back to "},{"id":"p7s11","text":"standard standby (`idle`) mode.
- **Sidebar Footer Toggle & Instant Dormant Sleep Mode**:
- Dedicate"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"d one-click toggle button rendered at the bottom of the DSH sidebar (`sidebar.footer.action` beside "},{"id":"p7s13","text":"Settings), fully responsive across expanded and rail modes;
- Features an instant "Put to Sleep" but"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"ton inside the cupboard header;
- Dormant mode completely unmounts the overlay DOM (zero screen occl"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"usion) and cuts off all LLM session event watchers and Token consumption, with instant millisecond w"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ake-up without page reloads.
- **Satiety Reserve Pool (Tokens as Food)**:
- 30,000 Token maximum cap"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"acity.
- Four tiers of rice food items on the shelf:
- `Grain of Rice` (+1 Token)
- `Spoon of Rice` "},{"id":"p7s18","text":"(+1,000 Tokens)
- `Bowl of Rice` (+3,000 Tokens)
- `Pot of Rice` (+10,000 Tokens)
- 5 perception tie"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"rs: `Starving!` (<2,000), `Very Hungry!` (2,000-5,000), `Not hungry, but wouldn't mind a snack!` (5,"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"000-10,000), `Satiated & Content` (10,000-20,000), and `Stuffed!` (>20,000).
- **Body & Bubble Size "},{"id":"p7s21","text":"Scaling Slider**:
- Continuous size scale slider located inside the cupboard drawer (50% to 180% ran"},{"id":"p7s22","text":"ge, 5% step).
- Scales both the whale maid pet and its speech bubble simultaneously in perfect propo"},{"id":"p7s23","text":"rtion.
- Features real-time percentage display and a quick "Reset" button to 100%, with preferences "},{"id":"p7s24","text":"persisted to disk and localStorage.
- **Universal DSH Model Auto-Discovery**:
- Automatically parses"},{"id":"p7s25","text":" and synchronizes all providers and models configured in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` (including custom Op"},{"id":"p7s26","text":"enAI-compatible proxies, Ollama, Claude, etc.) alongside DeepSeek official models.
- Automatically i"},{"id":"p7s27","text":"dentifies the active `agent-default-model` as the initial preference, and refreshes models dynamical"},{"id":"p7s28","text":"ly whenever the cupboard modal opens. Zero machine-specific hardcoding.
- **Mobile-Responsive Antiqu"},{"id":"p7s29","text":"e Cupboard Modal**:
- Automatically scales down proportionally based on viewport size (`min(92vw/640"},{"id":"p7s30","text":", 88vh/580)`) and centers smoothly on narrow mobile screens, eliminating clipping.
- **Instant Close"},{"id":"p7s31","text":" on Feed**: Tapping any rice item automatically closes the cupboard modal, allowing the user to watc"},{"id":"p7s32","text":"h the pet's thinking animation and response on the main screen right away.
- Smooth mobile momentum "},{"id":"p7s33","text":"scrolling on the speech ledger.
- **Speech Ledger & Dual-Layer Persistence**:
- Records up to 20 pas"},{"id":"p7s34","text":"t LLM dialogue entries including moods, timestamps, food/session titles, and tokens used.
- Stored c"},{"id":"p7s35","text":"oncurrently to disk (`pet_durable_memory.json`) and browser `localStorage`.
- **Context Awareness & "},{"id":"p7s36","text":"Strict Prompt Constraints**:
- Aggregates tasks completed in DSH within the past 5 hours to generate"},{"id":"p7s37","text":" tailored commentary and avoid repetitive responses.
- **Zero Emojis**: Strictly forbids all emojis "},{"id":"p7s38","text":"across all prompts, UI elements, and dialogues. Single-line JSON format bounded within 25 Chinese ch"},{"id":"p7s39","text":"l prompts, UI elements, and dialogues. The position persists across reloads.
2. **Open Cupboard**: Click or tap the whale maid's b"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ody to open the Maid Cupboard.
- Top shelf: View real-time satiety tokens and percentage.
- Middle s"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"helf: Click food items to feed. The cupboard modal closes automatically.
- Bottom shelf: Configure t"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"he active feeding model and browse/clear the speech ledger.
3. **Task Accompaniment**: Whenever a co"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ding session completes, the pet observes the task and comments with appropriate moods and token dedu"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ctions.
4. **Dismiss Bubble**: Click the speech bubble to close it and immediately return the pet to"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"miss Bubble**: Click the speech bubble to close it and immediately return the pet to `idle` standby."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 📂 Project Structure"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"This project is open-sourced under the MIT License."}],"truncated":false}
